description: Extracts build-system detection out of codebase_explorer's 14-line if-ladder into a BuildAdapter protocol + BuildAdapterRegistry with deterministic single/multi-match selection and an explicit Unknown fallback. Preserves codebase_explorer.detect_build_system's historical (build_system, test_framework) return tuple so the rung-1 smoke fixtures pass unchanged.
purpose: Rung 2 of the post-audit Claude-lane sequence. Establishes the adapter contract that real arbitrary-repo intake needs (monorepos, polyglot trees, custom test commands) without redesigning ShadowCompiler or moving the LLM-dependent paths. ShadowCompiler-vs-hive/compiler.py unification is reserved for PARALLEL_EXECUTION_LAYER_AUDIT_LOCK_001.

dataclasses: DetectionResult(matched: bool, confidence: float, evidence_files: list[str], notes: str)
ShadowBuildResult(ran: bool, success: bool, output: str, tool_missing: bool, timed_out: bool)
ParsedFinding(severity: str, category: str, message: str, file: str, line: int)
design_notes: Class-method based; no instance state — composes cleanly with the registry and is trivial to mock.
_run() helper wraps subprocess.run with FileNotFoundError -> tool_missing and TimeoutExpired -> timed_out (never raises).
Adapters are intentionally raw subprocess for this rung — sandboxing unification is PARALLEL_EXECUTION_LAYER_AUDIT_LOCK_001's scope.

adapters.name: Unknown
adapters.role: explicit fallback when no manifest matches

registry_selection_rules: detect_all(workspace) calls adapter.detect() on every adapter except UnknownAdapter; keeps those with matched=True and confidence > 0.
select(workspace) returns the primary adapter as a SelectionResult.
Zero matches -> UnknownAdapter explicitly, multi_match=False, note='no build manifest detected; UnknownAdapter selected'.
Multiple matches -> sort by (-priority, -confidence, build_system_id) deterministic tie-break; top is primary, multi_match=True, note enumerates the matched build_system_ids.

codebase_explorer_compat.deferred_note: Smoke fixtures do not exercise these. Migrating them is a follow-up adapter; absence is documented, not silent.

invariants: Every builtin adapter detects its own rung-1 fixture (Python -> python_broken, Rust -> rust_broken, Go -> go_broken).
No adapter false-positives across the three rung-1 fixtures.
Empty / no-manifest workspace returns UnknownAdapter (multi_match=False, explicit note), does NOT crash.
Polyglot synthetic workspace (Cargo.toml + go.mod + pyproject.toml) returns Rust as primary, multi_match=True, ordered match list contains all three build_system_ids.
select() is deterministic: same input -> same primary and same matched ordering across invocations.
discover_tests returns expected test command strings per language (pytest / cargo test / go test).
Unknown.discover_tests returns []. Unknown.run_shadow_build returns ran=False, success=True with explanatory output.
run_shadow_build returns tool_missing=True (does NOT raise) when the underlying binary is absent from PATH.

parse_failure produces ParsedFinding records with correct file/line extraction for Rust (E0308 + --> location) and Go (file.go:N:M:) formats; Python parse_failure recognizes pytest FAILED and Python syntax/indentation errors.
codebase_explorer.detect_build_system returns identical legacy (build, test) tuples for python_broken, rust_broken, go_broken after the migration.
CodebaseExplorer.explore() against the Python fixture still produces build_system='pip', test_framework='pytest', health<1.0.
Registry select() does not mutate the source tree.
Registry select() does not mutate any signed evidence file (evidence_index.json or locks/sentinel/*.json).
Corpus write guard (DETERMINEX_NO_CORPUS_WRITE=1) raises CorpusWriteBlockedError during the test session.
No DETERMINEX_*/HF_HOME/OLLAMA_* env vars required for registry select() to function.
safety_invariants: Adapters use raw subprocess.run with bounded timeout via _run(); FileNotFoundError -> tool_missing flag, TimeoutExpired -> timed_out flag — never propagate exceptions to callers.
UnknownAdapter.detect intentionally returns matched=False so the registry can construct its own explicit fallback selection — there is no silent passthrough.
Registry select() never writes to disk.
Tests that exercise toolchains (cargo, go) skip cleanly when the binary is not on PATH — no hard dependency on a particular dev host.
remaining_gaps: Bundler (Gemfile), Composer (composer.json), Mix (mix.exs), Make (Makefile), CMake (CMakeLists.txt) are NOT yet adapters — they fall through to UnknownAdapter. Not regressions: the smoke fixtures don't exercise them. Targeted in a follow-up.
Adapters still shell out via raw subprocess.run; they do not route through hive/compiler.py's hardened sandbox. Subject of PARALLEL_EXECUTION_LAYER_AUDIT_LOCK_001 (rung 4).
discover_tests returns suggested command strings only; it does not introspect pytest plugins, gradle test goals, npm script aliases, etc. Acceptable for this rung.
Confidence scoring is heuristic (Python: 0.65 + 0.15 per extra manifest). No formal calibration against real-world repos.
ShadowCompiler in codebase_explorer.py is not yet migrated to use adapter.run_shadow_build(); the migration footprint is intentionally narrow (only detect_build_system delegates).

Monorepos with per-subdirectory build systems (e.g. /backend/Cargo.toml + /frontend/package.json) are detected as if the root has both — registry sees them as multi-match. Per-subtree adapter scoping is future work.
